title: •Obi-Wan In _Radiant VII_

game_text: May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent’s starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.

notes: COMBO CARD — TALL FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1099 crop, the whole card face, not a bottom-half slip). Layout top to bottom, as the slip prints it on the printed card's blue Episode I-era starship frame: (1) TITLE BAR (silver): a round disc at the left — dark disc with a blue/white streaked starfighter image, identical to the disc on the printed Radiant VII (the Coruscant-era starship-type disc), not a character affiliation disc; title '•Obi-Wan In _Radiant VII_' in the Decipher title face with 'Radiant VII' italic; destiny 2 in the black hole at the right (unchanged). (2) LORE BOX: 'Optimized for diplomatic missions with sensor-proof / pods that have ejection capabilities. Easily identified by its / red coloration.' — first line indented; identical wording and line breaks to the printed card. Right of the lore box, top to bottom: the Coruscant expansion ring icon (pink sphere with yellow rim) and the black EPISODE I icon — both as on the printed card. (3) ART WINDOW: blank white on the slip (the printed art stays; renderer maps the art from the base scan). Copyright line not printed on the slip (stays from the printed card). (4) Starship half: banner STARFIGHTER: CORELLIAN REPUBLIC CRUISER; stat boxes POWER 4 / ARMOR 4 / HYPERSPEED 4; deploy 5 / forfeit 6 boxes left of the text box; no scomp ring; game text (4 lines: 'May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who / provides ability of 6. Opponent’s starships may not / cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.'); icon column top to bottom: Republic (silver Republic starship crest on lavender/white box), Pilot helmet on yellow (permanent pilot — LS Rebel helmet), Nav Computer (astromech dome on red); then the VS14 set sphere (orange). (5) Bottom strip: caption '•_Radiant VII_ (V)' (italic ship name), number 11. The heading above the slip reads '•Obi-Wan In _Radiant VII_ (V)'; stub page is 'Radiant VII (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)'. CHANGES vs Decipher Radiant VII (Coruscant, Cor-L-radiantvii.gif): title '•Radiant VII' → '•Obi-Wan In Radiant VII'; lore, destiny 2, disc, banner, ring icons unchanged; POWER 5 → 4 (ARMOR 4, HYPERSPEED 4 unchanged); deploy 4 → 5; forfeit 7 → 6; game text replaced (printed: 'May add 3 pilots and 3 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. While Madakor or Williams piloting, immune to Lateral Damage and attrition < 5.'); icon column Republic + Nav → Republic + permanent Pilot + Nav. Base title italic not certain on the 350 px scan — base_title marked _Radiant VII_ following the slip's caption. Base scan only 350 px; copyright not legible — Coruscant SE-style 2001 line taken from the PC's V1 Mace Windu (Coruscant) remake where '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' is legible (vs13/03 and vs13/08 used 2000). No modern remake found (no V*/VB* radiantvii file on the wiki). Lore matches the wiki. 'Opponent’s' curly apostrophe as printed. Stub text matches except '(*)Obi-Wan' = •Obi-Wan.
